title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Update Payment Information
content:
If a user wants to update their payment method:

- Direct them to the CultPass app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Settings'
- They can add, remove, or set a default payment method
- Accepted methods: credit/debit cards and select digital wallets
- Changes take effect on the next billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment information by going to 'My Account' and selecting 'Payment Settings' in the CultPass app. Any changes will apply to your next billing cycle."

title: How to Download or Access the CultPass App
content:
If a user asks where to find the app:

- Available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Search for 'CultPass' and install the official app
- Users can also access limited features via the CultPass website
- Recommend keeping the app updated for the best experience

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can download the CultPass app from the App Store or Google Play by searching 'CultPass'. For the best experience, make sure you're on the latest version."

title: How to View Upcoming or Past Experiences
content:
Users can track their reservations and history directly in the app:

- Upcoming events: App > 'My Experiences' > 'Upcoming'
- Past events: App > 'My Experiences' > 'History'
- QR codes for upcoming events are accessible from this screen
- Cancelled reservations will appear with a 'Cancelled' badge

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To view your upcoming or past experiences, go to 'My Experiences' in the CultPass app. Your QR codes for upcoming events are also accessible from there."

title: How to Refer a Friend
content:
CultPass offers a referral program for existing subscribers:

- Go to App > 'My Account' > 'Refer a Friend'
- Share the unique referral link via messaging or social media
- Both the referrer and the new subscriber receive a bonus experience upon signup
- Referral rewards are credited within 48 hours of the friend's first payment

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can refer a friend through the 'My Account' section in the app. Share your unique link, and once they subscribe, you'll both receive a bonus experience within 48 hours."

title: What to Do If a QR Code Doesn't Scan
content:
If a user reports their QR code isn't working at the venue:

- Ask them to increase screen brightness
- Ensure they are using the correct event QR code under 'My Experiences'
- Check that the event date and time are correct
- If the issue persists, advise them to show their confirmation email to venue staff
- Escalate to human support if entry is denied

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try increasing your screen brightness and make sure you're using the QR code under 'My Experiences'. If it still doesn't work, show your confirmation email to the venue staff."
tags: QR code, entry, scan, venue, troubleshooting

title: How to Change Account Email or Personal Details
content:
Users can update their personal information through the app:

- App > 'My Account' > 'Personal Information'
- Email changes require verification via a confirmation link sent to the new address
- Name and phone number can be updated immediately
- For issues with email changes, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To update your personal details, go to 'My Account' and select 'Personal Information'. If you're changing your email, you'll receive a confirmation link to verify the new address."

title: How to Gift a CultPass Subscription
content:
CultPass subscriptions can be gifted to friends or family:

- Purchase a gift subscription at cultpass.com/gift
- Choose the plan duration (1, 3, or 6 months)
- A gift code is sent to the buyer's email to forward to the recipient
- The recipient redeems it in-app via 'My Account' > 'Redeem Code'

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can gift a CultPass subscription at cultpass.com/gift. After purchase, you'll receive a code to share with the recipient, who can redeem it in the app under 'My Account'."

title: How to Filter and Discover Experiences
content:
Users can search and filter experiences in the catalog:

- Use the search bar or tap 'Explore' from the home screen
- Filter by category (art, music, film, etc.), date, location, or price
- Save favorites by tapping the bookmark icon on any experience
- Premium experiences are labeled with a 'Premium' badge

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can discover experiences by tapping 'Explore' in the app and using filters like category, date, and location. Bookmark any experience to save it for later."

title: What Happens If You Miss a Reserved Experience
content:
If a user did not attend a reserved experience:

- No-shows count against the monthly experience allowance
- The experience credit is not automatically refunded
- Users can request a one-time courtesy credit via in-app support (limit: once per 6 months)
- Encourage users to cancel in advance if they cannot attend

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Missed reservations still count toward your monthly allowance. If this was a one-time situation, you can request a courtesy credit through in-app support. Going forward, we recommend cancelling if you can't make it."

title: How to Contact Human Support
content:
For issues that cannot be resolved by the AI assistant:

- Direct users to App > 'Help' > 'Contact Support'
- Support is available via live chat (Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm) or email (response within 24h)
- For urgent issues (e.g., denied venue entry), live chat is recommended
- Always collect a brief description of the issue before escalating

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If I'm unable to resolve this for you, you can reach our support team through the 'Help' section in the app. Live chat is available Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm, or you can email us for a response within 24 hours."
tags: support, escalation, contact, live chat, help

title: How to Upgrade or Change a Subscription Plan
content:
Users can switch plans at any time through the app:

- App > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Change Plan'
- Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrade takes effect at next billing cycle
- Prorated charges may apply when upgrading mid-cycle
- Available plans and pricing are displayed during the plan selection flow

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your subscription plan under 'Manage Plan' in 'My Account'. Upgrades apply right away, while downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle."

title: How to Enable or Manage Notifications
content:
Users can control notification preferences within the app:

- App > 'My Account' > 'Notifications'
- Options include: event reminders, new experience alerts, promotional offers
- Push notifications must also be enabled at the device settings level
- If notifications are not arriving, check both app and device settings

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can manage your notification preferences under 'My Account' > 'Notifications'. Make sure push notifications are also enabled in your device settings for reminders to come through."

title: How to Redeem a Promo or Discount Code
content:
If a user has a promotional or discount code:

- App > 'My Account' > 'Redeem Code'
- Enter the code exactly as provided (codes are case-sensitive)
- Valid codes will display the discount or benefit before confirmation
- Codes cannot be combined with other offers unless stated
- Expired or invalid codes should be escalated to support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To redeem a promo code, go to 'My Account' and tap 'Redeem Code'. Enter your code exactly as shown — it's case-sensitive. If it's not working, feel free to reach out to our support team."
tags: promo code, discount, redeem, offer, promotion

title: How to Leave a Review for an Experience
content:
Users can rate and review experiences they have attended:

- App > 'My Experiences' > 'History' > select the experience > 'Leave a Review'
- Reviews consist of a star rating (1–5) and an optional written comment
- Reviews can be submitted up to 7 days after the event date
- Submitted reviews may be featured on the experience listing page

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can leave a review for any past experience by going to 'My Experiences' > 'History' and selecting the event. Ratings and comments can be submitted up to 7 days after the event."
